latest.title: How Mao’s Great Leap Forward Starved Millions
latest.desc:
Historian Frank Dikötter exposes the horrific truth behind Mao's Great Leap Forward.

It wasn't just a famine. Food was tied to work points, if you were sick, pregnant, or elderly, you were cut off from the canteens and left to starve.
